question: How many customers do we have?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM Customer

question: List all music genres.
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM Genre ORDER BY Name

question: How many invoices are from the USA?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM Invoice WHERE BillingCountry = 'USA'

question: What are the 5 longest tracks by duration?
gold_sql: SELECT Name, Milliseconds FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the first 10 artists in alphabetical order.
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM Artist ORDER BY Name LIMIT 10

question: Which country has the most customers?
gold_sql: SELECT Country, COUNT(*) AS n_customers FROM Customer GROUP BY Country ORDER BY n_customers DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the total revenue for each year?
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM InvoiceDate) AS year, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS revenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

question: Who is the top-selling artist by total revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name AS artist, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS revenue FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t USING(TrackId) JOIN Album al USING(AlbumId) JOIN Artist ar USING(ArtistId) GROUP BY ar.Name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the average invoice total across all invoices?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(Total), 2) AS avg_total FROM Invoice

question: List the top 10 best-selling tracks by revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT t.Name AS track, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS revenue FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t USING(TrackId) GROUP BY t.Name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10

question: How many tracks exist in each genre?
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name AS genre, COUNT(*) AS n_tracks FROM Track t JOIN Genre g USING(GenreId) GROUP BY g.Name ORDER BY n_tracks DESC

question: Which employee supports the most customers?
gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS employee, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS n_customers FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY employee ORDER BY n_customers DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the average invoice total per country, sorted highest first?
gold_sql: SELECT BillingCountry AS country, ROUND(AVG(Total), 2) AS avg_total FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY avg_total DESC

question: Who is the single highest-spending customer and what is their total spend?
gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName AS customer, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) AS spend FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c USING(CustomerId) GROUP BY customer ORDER BY spend DESC LIMIT 1

question: List artists whose total album revenue is greater than 20 dollars.
gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name AS artist, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS revenue FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t USING(TrackId) JOIN Album al USING(AlbumId) JOIN Artist ar USING(ArtistId) GROUP BY ar.Name HAVING SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) > 20 ORDER BY revenue DESC

question: Show monthly revenue for the year 2010.
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM InvoiceDate) AS month, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS revenue FROM Invoice WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM InvoiceDate) = 2010 GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: What is the most popular media type by number of tracks?
gold_sql: SELECT m.Name AS media_type, COUNT(*) AS n_tracks FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m USING(MediaTypeId) GROUP BY m.Name ORDER BY n_tracks DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the top 5 playlists by total track duration.
gold_sql: SELECT p.Name AS playlist, SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS total_ms FROM Playlist p JOIN PlaylistTrack pt USING(PlaylistId) JOIN Track t USING(TrackId) GROUP BY p.Name ORDER BY total_ms DESC LIMIT 5

question: Rank employees by the total revenue coming from their supported customers.
gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS employee, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) AS revenue FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId JOIN Invoice i USING(CustomerId) GROUP BY employee ORDER BY revenue DESC

question: How many customers have bought tracks from more than 5 different genres?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT c.CustomerId FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i USING(CustomerId) JOIN InvoiceLine il USING(InvoiceId) JOIN Track t USING(TrackId) GROUP BY c.CustomerId HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.GenreId) > 5) sub
